Definition: probably of Hebrew origin (feminine from H7965); Salome (i.e. Shelomah), an Israelitess:--Salome.
BiblicalUsage: Salome is an Israelitess, one of the women at the cross and the tomb. You find the name in Mark 15:40, "…also women looking on afar off: among whom…", and again in Mark 16:1.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Salome matters because God names his people one by one, and none of them is forgotten. I hold that no name in Scripture is there by accident.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
